title: Decision: -11 GCE-dictionary tests use hand-encoded Commits
description: Chosen by Mark 2026-11-04. mls-extensions-11 §4.6/§4.7 (PR #112) make a GroupContextExtensions proposal that changes app_data_dictionary always invalid. The five tests that built such Commits with mls-rs (no AppDataUpdate support) are rewritten with hand-encoded Commit bytes with byte-by-byte comments (as for hcfn), not an OpenMLS peer, since OpenMLS is the code under change.
